description: This file defines functions and types for updating and managing Matrix account configurations, including applying patches, cloning configs, and resolving config paths.

methods.name: applyNullableStringField
methods.description: Applies a nullable string value to a target object, trimming and deleting the key if null or empty.

methods.name: applyNullableSecretInputField
methods.description: Applies a secret input field, normalizing or coercing the value, or deleting the key if null or invalid.

methods.name: cloneMatrixDmConfig
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of a Matrix DM configuration object.

methods.name: cloneMatrixRoomMap
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of Matrix rooms or groups map.

methods.name: applyNullableArrayField
methods.description: Applies an array field to a target object, copying or deleting based on null or undefined.

methods.name: updateMatrixAccountConfig
methods.description: Updates the Matrix account configuration within the core config based on a patch object.
